item.title: Gunsmoke - Snap Decision
item.description: Disturbed over being forced to kill a prisoner who was trying to save his life, Matt Dillion turns in his badge.

item.title: The Big Valley - Ladykiller
item.description: Nick may become the latest victim of a family who preys upon male customers at their hotel. His pursuit of the young woman of the family gives them pause; should they kill him now or hope that a Stockton Barkley will marry her?

item.title: Wagon Train - The Ruttledge Munroe Story
item.description: Ruttledge Munroe joins the wagon train on the trail. His odd sense of humor is noticed right away, but when he saves the major's life it is forgotten. That is, until he kills someone else and the real reason he joined up is revealed.

item.title: The Wild Wild West - The Night of the Raven
item.description: Dr. Loveless' newest plan involves a powder that lets him miniaturize anyone who opposes him... and Jim West is his first target.

item.title: Bugs Bunny and Friends - Bugsy And Mugsy, Porky Chops, Skyscraper Caper, Pre-hysterical Hare, Don't Give Up The Sheep, Tweety's S.O.S., People Are Bunny
item.description: "Bugs undermines the operations of two criminals. , Porky, a lumberjack, is trying to chop down a tree, but a squirrel who lives there battles him to save it. , Daffy has a sleepwalking problem, and Speedy offers to help him. , Running from Elmer, Bugs is wondering why there is an annual rabbit hunting season. item.title: The Woody Woodpecker Show - Solid Ivory, Bee Bopped, Charlie the Rainmaker, The Loose Nut, Doc's Last Stand, Dizzy Kitty, Wild and Woody
item.description: "When the cue ball to Woody's billiard table falls into a hen house, Woody must rescue it from a hen who thinks it's one of her eggs., Windy the bee tries to teach his son the "right" way to steal honey from a beehive. item.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Mouse, Swing Shift Cinderella, Baby Puss
item.description: "Jerry drinks a potion that makes him grow to the size of a giant and decides to go after Tom this time. Academy Award nominee for 1948 Best Short Subject., Bored with chasing Red Riding Hood, the Wolf decides to go after Cinderella., A little girl makes Tom her baby cat and Jerry with some alley cats taunt the unfortunate feline."

item.title: Popeye and Pals - Beware of Barnacle Bill, Poor Cinderella, The Fistic Mystic
item.description: "Popeye and Olive sing their way through this cartoon in operetta style., Betty Boop goes to the ball thanks to the good fairy., Popeye matches his energy-packed can of spinach against the super-natural powers of an oriental mystic."

item.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Doctor Jed Clampett
item.description: Jed gets an honorary doctorate when he donates money to a college, and the family thinks he is now a legit doctor. However, Granny isn’t pleased with hearing that Jed is now a real college doctor because she didn’t go to college. Granny does her best to get a degree herself, but doesn’t find much success.

item.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Hedda Hopper's Hollywood
item.description: Mammoth Pictures is in danger of getting torn down, but Hedda Hopper wants to save it. She shows Jed the legacy of the stars of the studio, who stuck their hand prints in cement for the Walk of Fame. Misunderstanding this, Jed works to fill the prints in with wet cement.
